name: SAT-MTB-SOS
description: Satellite video object segmentation is capable on various applications such as specific events monitoring and outline moving details by continuously observing large areas. However, the small size of targets and appearance deformation make the Satellite video object segmentation more difficult, and the lack of satellite video datasets has limited the development of satellite video object segmentation. Therefore, it is necessary to establish a benchmark to fill the vacancies and advance the research. In this work, we present SAT-MTB-SOS, the first frame-by-frame and pixel-level annotated benchmark dataset for satellite video single object segmentation. SAT-MTB-SOS contains 113 high-quality video sequences with a total of 13,500 frames, covering five categories of typical targets in satellite videos: airplanes, trains, vehicles, ships, and buildings. notes: Non-LLM computer vision benchmark; small, specialized satellite video dataset with challenging occlusion, motion blur, and deformation.
